items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Quincy I actually did a recording for John Hammond on Vanguard and Quincy wrote one of the tunes, called “Funk Junction.”

ctx.x: Let me ask you about a couple of people here that you’ve played for or with or they’ve played with you. Quincy Jones?
Oh yeah. Quincy I actually did a recording for John Hammond on Vanguard and Quincy wrote one of the tunes, called “Funk Junction.” That was before he became very popular as a writer.
How about Chick Corea? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
